trend.rule: LONG when fast EMA > slow EMA; SHORT when fast EMA < slow EMA on 15m, 1h and 4h

funding.relative_research_rule: funding event z-score relative to prior events only; LONG z <= 0; SHORT z >= 0
funding.status: relative rule frozen for continued research; absolute rule retained as control

cvd.rule: LONG CVD EMA12 > EMA26; SHORT CVD EMA12 < EMA26

premium.rule: closed 15m premium compared with prior 96-bar causal distribution; LONG z <= 0; SHORT z >= 0

positioning.status: shadow/research; not promoted as hard filter

leverage_stress.status: shadow/research; not promoted as hard filter

cross_exchange.oi_rule: mean of Binance and Bybit dOI%; both venues required
cross_exchange.funding_rule: mean of Binance and Bybit funding z-scores; both venues required
cross_exchange.status: implemented but not benchmarked because Bybit public endpoints returned HTTP 403 from GitHub-hosted runners; no synthetic replacement permitted

benchmark_reference.selection_policy: Do not switch primary R:R retrospectively because another R:R looks better in-sample

research_governance.rule_changes_after_freeze: must create a new protocol version
research_governance.new_indicator_policy: add one graphical indicator family at a time and compare against this frozen baseline
research_governance.anti_overfit: no parameter choice may be justified solely by the best result on the frozen September sample
